from JIRA [DS-2081] created by pbecker

EPersons currently cannot be deleted in DSpace if they commited Items or took a task out of a workflow pool. This constraint should be overcome as g.e. the submitter is stored in an item's metadata in the provenance field as well.

This was discussed on dspace-devel [1] and in a developer meeting [2].

[1] http://dspace.2283337.n4.nabble.com/Deletion-of-EPersons-with-submitted-Item-td4673220.html
[2] http://irclogs.duraspace.org/index.php?date=2014-06-04
